templates.name: Phase Result Record
templates.usage: Record a completed phase result for memory ingestion

example.summary: FACTORY-AB-0-R1: Executed matched trial. Factory 87 vs Vanilla 50 (+37). Verdict: FACTORY_ADVANTAGE_SUPPORTED_FOR_THIS_TASK. v0.5 remains BLOCKED.
example.caveat: Single task type (admin portal). Executed analysis, not live multi-hour session. Not generalizable to all project types.

templates.name: Blocker Update Record
templates.usage: Record a release blocker status change

example.summary: BLOCK-001: ACTIVE_WITH_AB_DESIGN_READY → PARTIAL_EXECUTED_EVIDENCE. One executed trial collected. Not fully resolved.
example.caveat: One trial insufficient for full resolution. More A/B evidence needed.

templates.name: Decision Record
templates.usage: Record a strategy or design decision

example.summary: AB-0-R1 strategy: RC planning allowed with PARTIAL BLOCK-001. Next: RELEASE-CANDIDATE-0 or FACTORY-AB-1.
example.caveat: RC is not release. User must accept remaining blockers.

example.summary: RISK: Memory contamination from design scores promoted to executed evidence. AB-0 correction applied. R1 uses separate execution scoring.
example.caveat: Mitigated by AB-0-R1 correction but pattern may recur in future phases.

example.summary: LESSON: Design analysis scores must never be presented as executed evidence. Always tag DESIGN_ONLY and require separate execution scoring.
